answers.reason: As a member of the central university leadership, the vice president for studies takes part in the senate, which decides on the strategy and structure of the whole university.
The vice president for studies is responsible for teaching and studies, not the budget, and members do not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
The vice president for studies is responsible for degree programmes and teaching, not professorial appointments.
The vice president for studies holds a central university office and does not sit in bodies that decide the affairs of an individual faculty.
Although the study commission advises a faculty council, it deals directly with degree programmes and teaching, which fall under the responsibility of the vice president for studies.
The examination board decides on individual student matters at the faculty level, whereas the vice president operates at the central university level and only participates in one body.
The vice president for studies is responsible for teaching and studies, not internal faculty research funding.
Rewriting module descriptions for a single degree programme is a subordinate working task, and members only take part in the one body where their level of matters is decided.
Decisions about laboratory equipment are separate from study programmes and outside the remit of the vice president for studies.
Planning the orientation week is a local student-related task outside the central strategic remit of the vice president for studies.
